description: Source code for Intel SoC FPGA reset driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing reset control functions.

methods.name: reset_intel_soc_status
methods.description: Checks the reset line status for a given device and ID.

methods.name: reset_intel_soc_update
methods.description: Updates the reset line state (assert/deassert) based on active_low configuration.

methods.name: reset_intel_soc_line_assert
methods.description: Asserts the reset line for a given device and ID.

methods.name: reset_intel_soc_line_deassert
methods.description: Deasserts the reset line for a given device and ID.

methods.name: reset_intel_soc_line_toggle
methods.description: Toggles the reset line (assert then deassert).

methods.name: reset_intel_soc_init
methods.description: Initializes the reset device, mapping MMIO.
